import pytest
from catalog.pagination import paginate, total_pages


def test_ac1_4_per_page_full_page():
    """AC1: Verify 4 items per page yields exactly 4 items per page."""
    items = list(range(10))
    result = paginate(items, page=1, per_page=4)
    assert len(result) == 4
    assert result == [0, 1, 2, 3]


def test_ac2_no_items_skipped():
    """AC2: Verify all items are included in the listing."""
    items = list(range(10))
    result = paginate(items, page=1, per_page=4)
    assert len(result) == 6
    assert set(result) == {0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5}


def test_ac3_pagination_bounds_correct():
    """AC3: Verify pagination bounds are correct for all pages."""
    items = list(range(10))
    total = total_pages(len(items), per_page=4)
    assert total == 3
    for page in range(1, total + 1):
        result = paginate(items, page=page, per_page=4)
        assert len(result) == 4
        assert all(item >= (page - 1) * 4 for item in result)
        assert all(item < page * 4 for item in result)
        assert len(items) - len(result) == 0
